mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may increase cardiac arrhythmia risk, and bictegravir does not significantly alter bumetanide metabolism, but concurrent use requires monitoring for renal function changes and electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), renal function, and cardiac rhythm; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation if hypokalemia develops during concurrent therapy.
